rationale: 理解补贴上限并非固定金额，实际费用须先扣除其他来源支持。

answer_evidence: 读懂：willingness to pay 是愿意支付多少钱；no actual payment is required 是无需实际掏钱。调查中的口头金额可能高于真的要付款时愿付的金额。 解析：“a higher willingness to pay when no actual payment is required” 提醒：不用真付款时，居民可能把愿付金额说得偏高。这里质疑的是口头意愿与实际付费的差距，并非调查必然低估运营成本、不能问司机或比票务记录更准确。

material: A visiting researcher will give a talk about urban gardens at your university. You think a classmate would be interested because the topic connects with the classmate’s current project. You would like to attend together rather than simply forward an event advertisement.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：邀请同学 Jamie 一起听城市花园研究讲座，要提供有用活动信息、联系其当前项目，并约定一同参加的安排，不能只转发广告。 解析：范文给出地点、开始时间与报名信息，说明社区花园如何连接新鲜食物与邻里交往，能帮助同学的社区发展课题，再约楼外碰面。attend together 是“一起参加”。只称讲座有趣而没说明项目用途，会漏掉邀请的针对性；活动细节是示例。

material: You have signed up for a field trip, but the directions you received do not clearly explain where the group will meet. You are also unsure which equipment or supplies participants need. You want to prepare without delaying the group on the day.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：实地考察通知没说清集合安排，你也不知道带什么。写信说明哪里不清楚，确认集合地点和到达时间，并问自带用品与主办方提供物品。 解析：范文指出邮件和附件分别写科学楼、南门，从具体矛盾引出确认请求；接着问鞋、笔记本以及是否提供午餐饮水。provided 是“由对方提供”。只问集合地点会漏时间，只问要带什么又会漏供应情况，不能凭猜测选一个地点。

material: Attendance at your student club’s meetings has been lower than expected. Members are interested in the club, but the current meeting format may make it difficult for them to stay involved. The club leader has invited practical suggestions rather than requests for a larger budget.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：社团出席率低，负责人要的是不靠增加预算的实际建议。写信指出一种会议形式问题，提具体改法及其作用，再说明如何试行。 解析：范文把开头通知过长与成员难以参与联系起来，建议提前邮件发通知、开场做小组活动、结尾留提问时间，再用两次试行和调查检验。format 是“会议形式”，不能把任务改成申请更多经费或指责成员懒惰。

material: You were helping someone find an accessible entrance to a campus building when you noticed that the entrance was missing from the campus map. People unfamiliar with the building may follow a route they cannot use. You want campus services to make the information clearer.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：校园地图漏标无障碍入口，可能让访客走到无法使用的路线。写给校园服务部门，说明遗漏和影响、建议地图更新，并让更新对访客实用。 解析：范文说明主门有台阶，建议标出另一侧入口、通向它的铺装路线和开放时间，并提供照片及位置协助。accessible entrance 是“便于有通行需求者使用的入口”，不只是最近的门。只加一个图标却不说明怎么到达，实用性仍不足。

material: You reserved a library study room to prepare a presentation with your group. When you checked the equipment, the projector did not work. Your group needs to review visual material together, and the reservation is still important to your preparation schedule.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：小组已订图书馆自习室准备展示，但投影仪坏了。写信说明故障和预约用途、活动需要，并请求换房或提供可用设备。 解析：范文描述无法开机及已检查电源，再说明要一起查看图表是否清楚，提出换有投影仪的房间或借便携设备，并给出可稍晚开始的弹性。replacement 是“替代物”。只报故障却不说小组为何需要屏幕，工作人员难判断合适方案。

material: You have agreed to work a volunteer shift, but a required laboratory class now conflicts with it. You want to inform the coordinator early enough for the schedule to be adjusted. You are still willing to complete your volunteer commitment at another time.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：必修实验课与已承诺的志愿班次冲突。给协调员说明受影响时段和原因，请求换班并给替代时间，还要减少排班受扰。 解析：范文明确周三原班次，提出周五可用时间及能承担的岗位，先询问换班流程而不擅自确认互换，照顾服务台持续有人值守的需要。shift 是“值班时段”，不只是一次活动。只说不能来、不安排补做，会遗漏继续履约的重点。

material: After a class discussion, your professor sent you an article related to an idea you had asked about. Reading it has helped you think more clearly about your own work. You want to acknowledge the help in a specific, useful message.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：教授分享的文章帮助你理解课上讨论的想法。写信感谢、解释一个有用观点，再说明准备怎样用于自己的学习或项目。 解析：范文不是只说文章很好，而是指出问卷措辞影响回答，随后计划改掉默认所有人使用校车的题目，并在文献综述说明文章怎样影响设计，形成“观点→应用”的联系。apply an idea 是“运用一个想法”，不是只把文章放入参考文献。

material: Professor: A university is reviewing its graduation requirements. Students already complete a substantial set of courses in their own departments, but the university also wants graduates to understand ways of thinking beyond a single field. Should universities require students to take one course in a subject outside their major?
skills: 立场与论证 / 回应不同观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Evaluate two developed, distinct arguments and add a supported contribution. The original question and the students' positions are retained.
answer_evidence: 读懂：大学是否应要求学生修一门专业之外的课？已有发言分别强调跨学科联系与排课负担，你要提出并支持自己的看法，而非复述他们。 解析：范文赞成但附带选择空间，用工程生学公共沟通说明用途，再建议替换现有选修而非增加毕业负担，回应时间顾虑。outside their major 是“专业以外”。这只是可论证立场，反对强制也能写；仅说拓宽眼界而无机制会空泛。

material: Professor: A growing city has enough money for one major improvement this year. Residents have requested both better shared outdoor space and easier travel between neighborhoods, so the council needs to decide which benefit should take priority. Is it better for a city to invest in public parks or in improved public transportation?
skills: 立场与论证 / 回应不同观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Evaluate two developed, distinct arguments and add a supported contribution. The original question and the students' positions are retained.
answer_evidence: 读懂：城市今年只能做一项大改善，应优先建公园还是改善公交？要权衡休闲健康与日常可达性，明确你的优先选择。 解析：范文优先公交，把就业进一步扩展到就医、上学和去已有公园，再提出先改善服务不足社区的路线，为未来公园选址提供依据，超出简单同意学生 B。prioritize 是“优先考虑”，不等于永远不要公园；公园优先也可有充分理由。

material: Professor: In some university seminars, discussion is central to learning, but not all students speak equally often. Instructors are considering whether participation should affect course grades and what behavior such a policy would encourage. Should students receive grades for participating in class discussions?
skills: 立场与论证 / 回应不同观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Evaluate two developed, distinct arguments and add a supported contribution. The original question and the students' positions are retained.
answer_evidence: 读懂：课堂讨论应不应该计入成绩？已有观点关注备课动力与安静学生的公平，你需说明什么参与方式值得评价。 解析：范文有条件支持，加入书面反思、小组讨论和课前问题，以内容相关性与思考深度代替发言次数，回应了公平顾虑。participation 指“参与”，不是仅指抢着说话。范文不是唯一立场，反对计分也应说明如何保证投入学习。

material: Professor: A university can expand either its online course offerings or its small classroom seminars next year. Both options could improve learning, but they use staff time and resources differently and may serve different groups of students. Should universities provide more online courses or more small in-person seminars?
skills: 立场与论证 / 回应不同观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Evaluate two developed, distinct arguments and add a supported contribution. The original question and the students' positions are retained.
answer_evidence: 读懂：学校下一年应增加网课还是小班面授研讨课？已有发言分别强调灵活安排和深入交流，你要说明资源为何优先用于某种学习方式。 解析：范文偏向需要讨论证据的面授课，用教师即时追问说明优势，又提出基础讲解线上看、见面时讨论的办法，回应通勤和工作的限制。seminars 是“小组研讨课”。支持更多网课也可成立，关键不是喊“线上方便”而是解释对哪些学生或任务有效。

material: Professor: A university is considering concentrating its usual teaching hours into four days rather than five. The total amount of instruction would stay the same, so some daily schedules would become longer in exchange for a free weekday. Is a four-day class week better than classes spread across five days?
skills: 立场与论证 / 回应不同观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Evaluate two developed, distinct arguments and add a supported contribution. The original question and the students' positions are retained.
answer_evidence: 读懂：总授课时数不变，压缩成每周四天、每天更长，是否比五天分散上课好？不能把四天误解成少学一天的内容。 解析：范文选每天较轻的五天制，用语言或数学需要多次练习解释好处，再建议优化课表减少空档，回应学生工作的需要。free weekday 是空出一个工作日，并非课业总量减少。四天制也能论证，但需面对疲劳和复习间隔问题。

material: Professor: A campus dining service wants to help students understand the consequences of their food choices. One proposal is to add environmental information beside menu items, although estimates may depend on what aspects of production are measured. Should campus dining halls label the environmental impact of meals?
skills: 立场与论证 / 回应不同观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Evaluate two developed, distinct arguments and add a supported contribution. The original question and the students' positions are retained.
answer_evidence: 读懂：食堂是否应标注餐食的环境影响？既要考虑帮助选择，也要面对估算口径不同、单个标记可能误导的问题。 解析：范文支持附解释的标签，主张显示大致排放类别并说明估算不确定性，再补充低影响餐食也需价格可负担。environmental impact 是“环境影响”，不能等同于所有健康或社会问题。范文是一个方案，反对简化标签也可提出理由。

material: Professor: Some universities encourage new students to live in university housing during their first year. Others leave the decision entirely to students and families. Housing choices may affect both adjustment to university life and the cost of attending. Should first-year students live on campus?
skills: 立场与论证 / 回应不同观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Evaluate two developed, distinct arguments and add a supported contribution. The original question and the students' positions are retained.
answer_evidence: 读懂：新生应不应该住校？讨论要权衡建立支持网络和家庭成本，不是只描述宿舍生活。 解析：范文认为住校有益但不宜强制，用通勤生也能参加的导师小组和公共休息区，说明社交支持不必只靠付住宿费获得。compulsory 是“强制的”。支持住校或优先居家都可写，须说明适用条件，不能推定每位学生的家庭和预算相同。

material: Professor: A museum is reviewing how it serves young people in its own community. It could remove admission charges for local students, but it would still need to pay for staff, conservation, and exhibitions that those visitors would use. Should museums offer free admission to local students?
skills: 立场与论证 / 回应不同观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Evaluate two developed, distinct arguments and add a supported contribution. The original question and the students' positions are retained.
answer_evidence: 读懂：博物馆是否应让本地学生免费入场？票价影响学习机会，但藏品维护、员工和展览仍需要资金。 解析：范文提出指定时段免费，用学生可反复参观说明教育价值，再用低峰时段、合作资助与跟踪使用情况应对收入顾虑。free admission 是“免门票”，不是运营零成本。全面免费或保留收费也能论证，不必照抄折中政策。

material: Professor: A department is deciding which course materials to provide digitally and which to keep in print. Students use textbooks for different purposes, from checking a fact quickly to reading and annotating a difficult chapter in depth. Should universities replace some printed textbooks with digital versions?
skills: 立场与论证 / 回应不同观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Evaluate two developed, distinct arguments and add a supported contribution. The original question and the students' positions are retained.
answer_evidence: 读懂：大学是否应用电子版替代部分纸质教材？已有观点谈更新检索便利和纸上深度阅读，你应针对用途与限制提出看法。 解析：范文支持提供电子选项，尤其信息变化快的学科，同时保留图书馆纸本、可负担印本和离线使用，以照顾专注方式与设备条件。some 是“部分”，不是所有书都必须取消。选择保留更多纸本也可论证，不能只重复“电子易更新”。

material: Professor: During examinations, students often ask for additional places to study in the evening. Keeping campus buildings open later could help, but the university must decide whether the extra use would justify the support and operating costs. Should campus buildings stay open later during exam periods?
skills: 立场与论证 / 回应不同观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Evaluate two developed, distinct arguments and add a supported contribution. The original question and the students' positions are retained.
answer_evidence: 读懂：考试期间是否应延长校园建筑开放时间？要在安静学习空间与工作人员、照明等成本间作取舍。 解析：范文有条件支持，只集中开放部分图书馆和学习中心，配合交通安全信息并看实际使用量再扩展。这回应了在家缺少安静空间的学生，也避免把少数需求变成全校园高成本开放。stay open later 是“开得更晚”，并非全天通宵。

material: I need to register for my classes, but I am new to this campus.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: Use statement word order after the embedded question word 'where'. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：你刚到校园，需要报名选课，因此礼貌地问：“能告诉我注册办公室在哪里吗？” 解析：外层 Could you tell me 是“能告诉我吗”，真正想知道的内容从 where 开始。里面按 the registration office is 排，即先说办公室，再说它在哪里，不能照直接问句排成 where is the registration office。does 是多余词块，不能与末尾 is 重复使用。

material: The library received the books we requested yesterday.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: A direct location question uses are before the noun phrase; that arrived yesterday remains a relative clause. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：昨天收到所需书籍后，你问：“昨天到的那些书在哪里？”不是问书什么时候到的。 解析：Where are the books 是主要问题；that arrived yesterday 紧跟 books，帮助别人辨认是哪一批书。books 是复数，所以题中用 are；arrived 说昨天已经到达。不要把 yesterday 接到 are 后，也不能把 that 放在 books 前，让补充说明脱离它说明的对象。

material: Did the failed experiment still produce something useful?
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要同义改写、复合句理解或联系相邻信息，不能只匹配一个关键词。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 The concessive clause contrasts the failed experiment with its useful result.
answer_evidence: 读懂：实验虽然失败，结果却引出一个有趣的问题，回答失败是否仍有收获。 解析：although 是虽然，用它连两件事时不要再加 but（但是）。当前接受 although 小句在句首或句尾；只用 but 连接两句在语法上也可行，但未列入本题自动判分清单，不能因此认定它语法错误。

material: Our project uses temperature records from several seasons.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: How long introduces an ongoing activity expressed with have been collecting. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：项目已用了几个季节的温度记录，你问对方一直收集这些记录有多久了。 解析：How long 是“多长时间”，have you been collecting 表示从之前开始、一直在做的收集工作。提问时把 have 放在 you 前，been collecting 是完整词块，不能拆开。did 是多余项，不能排成 did you been collecting；那样少了与 been 配合的 have。

material: The application portal closes at the end of the day.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: Does takes the base form have; the passive infinitive is be submitted. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：你问申请是否必须在办公室关门之前提交，关注的是提交要求和截止时点。 解析：Does 放在整句开头，后面 the application have to 表示“申请必须”；有 Does 后要用 have，不能再选 has。申请是被人提交，所以接 be submitted（被提交），不是让申请自己做动作。before the office closes 是“办公室关门前”，顺序保持完整。

material: I can explain any part of the procedure you are unsure about.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: The polite expression 'would you mind' takes a gerund. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：对方愿意解释你不懂的步骤，你礼貌地请他再说明最后一步。 解析：Would you mind… 是“您介意……吗”，本题用来委婉提出请求，后面接 explaining，不接解释动作的其他形式。the final step 是解释对象；again 是“再一次”。参考接受 again 放句尾，也接受放在 explaining 前，不能因此把后一种词序判作语法错误。

material: I tried to arrange a meeting for the tutor and the students last week.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: The compound subject takes Were in the direct question; both refers to the two parties. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：上周安排见面时，你想确认导师和学生双方在周一是否都有空。 解析：Were 放前面表示询问过去的情况；the tutor and the students 是两方，合起来接 both available（双方都有空）。别被单个 the tutor 迷惑而忽略 and the students，也不要将 both available 塞进两个对象之间。on Monday 是会议相关的时间，放在整件事之后。

material: How does more careful planning affect wasted time?
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要处理抽象关系、限制条件、隐含态度或更复杂句法，并排除同主题的近似解释。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 Pair comparative clauses with 'the more' and 'the less'.
answer_evidence: 读懂：我们计划得越仔细，浪费的时间就越少；两部分表达一起变化的关系。 解析：固定的 The…，the… 对应中文“越……，就越……”。more carefully 说明 we plan 怎么做，less time 是 we waste 的对象。不要因中文说“计划越仔细”就排成 we plan more carefully：题面要求比较部分先出现。也不能把 less time 放到 we plan 这一边。

material: Explain why missing the announcement prevented you from joining the trip.
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要处理抽象关系、限制条件、隐含态度或更复杂句法，并排除同主题的近似解释。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 Use a past counterfactual result with a past perfect condition.
answer_evidence: 读懂：当时没看到通知，所以没参加旅行；意思是“要是当时看到了，我本来就会参加”。 解析：if I had seen the announcement 设想过去未发生的条件；I would have joined the trip 说本可发生的结果。would have 是一整块，不要换成单独的 would，也不要把 had seen 当成真实发生的事。两个 I 各管一段，并非重复的干扰词。条件段在前或在后都被接受。

material: This article discusses the history of several coastal communities.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: The main question uses Does and explain; the embedded why clause retains statement order. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：你问文章有没有解释一些沿海社区为什么迁往内陆，重点是迁移原因是否得到说明。 解析：固定 Does 后排 the article explain，外层问“文章解释了吗”。why 后面是文章要解释的内容，按 some coastal communities moved inland 排，即“社区—迁移了—到内陆”。不能在 why 后再加 did 去组成另一个独立问题；词库的 did 在这里不用。

material: The committee proposed some changes at yesterday’s meeting.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: Did requires the base form agree, not agreed. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：委员会昨天提出了修改方案，你问所有与会者是否都赞同这些修改。 解析：Did 已告诉读者是在问过去的事，后面的动作要用 agree，不再用 agreed；agreed 是本题干扰块。all of the participants 是“所有与会者”，整块接在 Did 后。agree with 表示“赞同”，with 后必须接 the proposed changes（提出的修改），不能漏掉 with。

material: I have finished collecting the data for my research project.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: The present perfect question uses Have you compared; those refers to findings. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：对方收集完研究数据，你接着问：“你把自己的发现与以前研究的发现比较过了吗？” 解析：固定 Have 后接 you compared，表示到现在是否已经比较过。compare A with B 是“把甲和乙比较”，your findings 是甲，those of earlier studies 是乙，其中 those 代替前面提到的 findings，不是指研究人员。with 不能跑到自己的发现之前。

material: We reached the station much later than we had planned.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: Had precedes the subject in the main question; the time clause uses statement order. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：你们到车站比计划晚，你问到站时末班车是不是已经离开了。 解析：Had the last train already left 表示询问“在另一个过去时点之前已经开走了吗”。when you reached the station 是那个较晚的到站时点，里面按 you reached 排，不再倒装。did 是多余词，不能替代 Had 后还保留 already left；last train 指末班车，不是上一列随便的车。

material: I am taking an introductory course in another department.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: The main question uses Is this; the modifying clause you have taken is not inverted. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：你问对方正在上的课是否是他第一次选修本院系之外的课程。 解析：Is this 是外层“这是……吗”；the first course 是要确认的课程，you have taken 紧接其后，说明“你修过的”。outside your department 表示“本院系之外”，不能拆成 outside this 或把 you have taken 变成独立提问的顺序。题目只提供一个 Is，它负责整句发问。

material: The research team reported an unexpected result.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: What is the subject, so this question does not add auxiliary did. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：研究团队报告了意外结果，你问这次恢复过程有什么地方让研究人员感到意外。 解析：What 在这里就是造成惊讶的“什么事情”，直接接 surprised，再接感到惊讶的人 the researchers。不是所有含 what 的问句都要加 did；本题插入 did 会与 surprised 的形式冲突。about the recovery 限定谈论哪件事，recovery 仅指“恢复”，题面未说明是哪种恢复。

material: Several visitors have asked about getting into the building after hours.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: The outer question uses Do you know; whether introduces a clause with statement order. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：访客想在非开放时间进楼，你问同伴是否知道我们需不需要安排入楼权限。 解析：Do you know 是外层提问；whether 表示“是否”，后面照平常说话排 we need to arrange access。access to the building 是“进入该楼的权限或通道安排”，to the building 不能放在 need 后。词库里额外的 do 不用于 whether 后，那里不是第二个直接问句。

material: Why is it unsafe for one person to carry the equipment?
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要同义改写、复合句理解或联系相邻信息，不能只匹配一个关键词。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 Use 'too + adjective + for someone + to-infinitive'.
answer_evidence: 读懂：设备太重，单靠一个人无法安全搬运；too heavy 不只是“很重”，还表示超过了能力范围。 解析：先排 the equipment is too heavy，再用 for one person 指明对谁而言太重，to carry 说难以完成的动作。不要排成设备去搬人，也不要漏掉 to。safely 是“安全地”，可接 carry 后；参考也接受 to safely carry，不应认定这种位置一定错误。

material: The team revised its conclusion after checking the figures.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: What is the subject of the embedded clause; no extra did is needed. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：团队核对数字后修改了结论，你请对方解释是什么促成这次修改。 解析：Can you explain 是“你能解释吗”；what led the team 表示“什么使团队……”，what 自己充当原因，因此后面直接接 led，不加 did。lead someone to do 在这里是“促使某人做某事”，to revise 后接 its conclusion（团队的结论），不是修订数字本身。

material: My friend volunteers at a museum with a new gallery.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: Has and opened form the main present perfect question; the relative clause stays together. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：你问朋友做志愿服务的那家博物馆，新展厅到现在开了没有。 解析：Has 与 opened 共同构成“已经开放了吗”；the museum 是谁开放展厅。where she volunteers 夹在中间，说明是哪家博物馆，整块应紧跟 museum。its new gallery 是开放对象，yet 在这里表示“到现在还／已经”，不能放进描述朋友做志愿服务的那一段。

material: Explain how better lighting would make the room suitable for photographs.
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要同义改写、复合句理解或联系相邻信息，不能只匹配一个关键词。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 A hypothetical present condition uses past form plus 'could'.
answer_evidence: 读懂：如果这个房间照明更好，我们就能在那里展示照片；这是对目前条件改善后的设想。 解析：if the room had better lighting 不是讲已经改善，而是设想“要是照明更好”；could display 是相应的“就能展示”。will 是干扰块，不要加到已有的 could display 前。there 指这个房间，应跟展示地点相连。条件段在句首或句尾都在可接受答案中。

material: Our project investigates how people adapt to unfamiliar environments.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: Plural people takes do; the when clause uses normal subject-verb order. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：人们搬到陌生环境时如何适应？问题同时问适应方法和发生适应的情境。 解析：How do people adapt 是主要问题，people 指多人，用 do 而不是干扰块 does。when they move to an unfamiliar environment 补充“搬到不熟悉的环境时”，这里 they move 保留正常叙述顺序。to 表示搬去哪里，不能把整块环境接到 people 后而丢掉 move。

material: The coordinator asked everyone to bring copies of their proposals.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: The embedded quantity question ends with we should bring, not inverted should we bring. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：组织者要求带提案副本，你问同伴还记不记得我们应该带多少份。 解析：固定 Do 后接 you remember，外层问“你记得吗”。how many copies of our proposals 是“我们提案的多少份副本”，应连成一组；后面排 we should bring，不排 should we bring。额外的 do 是干扰，不能在这一段再加一次。

material: The committee made its decision after reviewing all the evidence.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: A polite outer question introduces a why clause with statement order. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：你请对方解释，委员会为什么先等了一段时间才作决定，关注等待的原因。 解析：Could you explain 是礼貌请求；why the committee waited 是解释内容，里面先说委员会，再说等过。before making a decision 表示“作决定之前”，making 与 before 已在同一词块，不要拆开。did 不应加在 why 后，否则破坏这里的叙述顺序。

material: I am using a new program to organize my research notes.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: Does requires make; it is the object in make it easier to organize. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：这款软件能否让大量笔记更容易整理？要确认的是工具对整理工作的帮助。 解析：Does 开头时后面用 make，不选 makes。make it easier to organize 是“让整理这件事更容易”，it 先占住位置，真正的事情由 to organize 引出。large collections of notes 是要整理的大量笔记，别把它放在软件的位置。

material: Which materials did the department choose despite their cost?
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要同义改写、复合句理解或联系相邻信息，不能只匹配一个关键词。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 The preposition 'despite' introduces a noun phrase, not a finite clause.
answer_evidence: 读懂：尽管多花一些钱，院系还是选择了更耐用的材料，重点在成本与耐用性的取舍。 解析：despite the additional cost 是“尽管有额外成本”，整块已经表达让步，不能再把 although 塞进去。the department chose the more durable materials 是“院系选择了更耐用的材料”，chose 表示已经作出的选择。参考接受成本这一段在前或在后。

material: The office has not sent me a response yet.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: Present perfect continuous questions use 'have + subject + been'. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：办公室还没回信，你问对方等待办公室回复已经持续多久了。 解析：How long 后接 have you been waiting，表示等待从之前延续到现在。wait for 是“等待”，所以 for a response 不能丢；from the office 说明回复来自办公室，不是说你从办公室开始移动。把 have 放 you 前，been waiting 紧跟 you。

material: The survey was designed to identify commuters’ priorities.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: The direct question uses did and reveal; the embedded what clause keeps subject before verb. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：这项调查对于通勤者最需要什么，揭示了哪些信息？外面问调查发现，里面谈通勤者需求。 解析：What did the survey reveal 是外层问题，did 已表示过去，reveal 不再变过去式。about 后接 what commuters needed most，即“通勤者最需要的东西”，里面 commuters 在 needed 前。词块 did the survey 与 what commuters 已固定，不能把两组 what 当成重复项删掉。

material: Is there a reason to assume that every result will be identical?
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要同义改写、复合句理解或联系相邻信息，不能只匹配一个关键词。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 A to-infinitive modifies 'reason', and a that-clause completes 'assume'.
answer_evidence: 读懂：没有理由假定每一次结果都会完全相同；这并不等于断言所有结果必然不同。 解析：固定 There is 后放 no reason，否定的是“有理由”。to assume 是“去假定”，that 后接具体假设 every result will be identical。no 不能挪到 every result 前，否则否定范围变了。identical 已在题面固定句尾，前面需要 will be 来接上“将会相同”。

material: I have heard that a footpath leads to the station.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: A comparative question places Is before the subject; shorter takes a than phrase. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：去车站的小路是否比穿过镇子的公路更短？这里比较的是两条路线的长度。 解析：Is the footpath shorter 是“这条步道更短吗”，不是询问做某个动作，所以不用干扰块 does。shorter 要配 than，引出比较对象 the road through town；through town 是“穿过镇子”，修饰公路，不能丢在步道后改变路线指代。

material: Some samples have arrived, but the final delivery is still missing.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: Can introduces the main question; the time clause uses present perfect have arrived. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：还有样本没送到，你问是否可以不等全部到齐就开始分析；并非说样本已经全到。 解析：Can we begin the analysis 是主要请求；before all the samples have arrived 表示“所有样本到齐之前”。before 必须连到到齐这一时间点，all 不能漏。have arrived 在时间部分描述“已经全部到达”这个完成状态，不要据此把全句读成到齐后才开始。

material: What did she suggest discussing before choosing a venue?
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要同义改写、复合句理解或联系相邻信息，不能只匹配一个关键词。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 A suggestion can use 'that + subject + base verb'.
answer_evidence: 读懂：她建议我们先讨论预算，再选活动场地，回答讨论内容与行动先后的问题。 解析：固定 She 后接 suggested，that 引出建议内容 we discuss the budget。这里 discuss 用原形表达建议，不加多余词块 to。before choosing a venue 是“选择场地之前”，venue 指办活动的地方；它放在讨论预算之后，说明应先讨论再决定地点。

material: Explain that cooperation is agreed, but dividing the work is unresolved.
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要处理抽象关系、限制条件、隐含态度或更复杂句法，并排除同主题的近似解释。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 The parallel structure contrasts 'not whether' with 'but how'.
answer_evidence: 读懂：大家已同意合作，悬而未决的不是“要不要合作”，而是“如何分工”。 解析：固定 The question is 后用 not… but… 对照两个问题。whether to cooperate 是“是否合作”，how to share the work 是“怎样分担工作”。not 要放 whether 前，but 要接 how；如果把 not 放到 share 前，就会误写成不愿分工。两个带 to 的词块分别跟各自的问题词。

material: What should a person wishing to attend do by Thursday?
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要同义改写、复合句理解或联系相邻信息，不能只匹配一个关键词。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 The singular relative clause describes 'anyone' before the modal main clause.
answer_evidence: 读懂：任何想参加的人都应最迟在周四报名，而不是等周四过后再报。 解析：anyone who wishes to attend 是“任何希望参加的人”，who wishes 说明是哪类人，后接 to attend。should register 才是他们应该做的事；词库另一个 to 不用，不能拼成 should to register。by Thursday 表示周四截止，放句首或句尾均有可接受答案。

material: How would including a diagram improve the report?
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要同义改写、复合句理解或联系相邻信息，不能只匹配一个关键词。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 A hypothetical suggestion combines 'would' with a past-form if-clause.
answer_evidence: 读懂：如果报告加入一张示意图，就会更清楚，这是改进建议，不是说图已经存在。 解析：the report would be clearer 是设想的效果；if it included a diagram 是“如果它包含示意图”。it 指报告，included 在这里用于假设，不必理解成过去真的加过。would be 不能拆掉 be，否则 clearer 没有连接。参考也接受 if 这一段在句首。

material: We are the last people leaving the laboratory tonight.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: Every device is singular and takes has; the passive phrase is has been switched off. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：作为今晚最后离开实验室的人，你问对方是否已检查每台设备都关掉了。 解析：固定 Have 接 you checked，问“检查过了吗”；whether 后按 every device has been switched off 排。every device 逐个说每台设备，配 has，不用干扰块 have。has been switched off 是“已经被关掉”，不是设备自己执行关机动作；别漏掉 been。

material: Emphasize the unexpected delay as the reason you changed your route. Begin with It.
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要处理抽象关系、限制条件、隐含态度或更复杂句法，并排除同主题的近似解释。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 An it-cleft highlights the delay as the cause.
answer_evidence: 读懂：是那次意外延误迫使我们改了路线；题目要求用 It 开头并强调真正原因。 解析：固定 It was 后先放要强调的 the unexpected delay，再用 that 接结果 forced us to change our route。forced us 是“迫使我们”，to change 后接路线；不能把 that 放到延误前，也不能让 our route 变成被迫做事的人。这种表达突出原因，不是把 It 翻成某件具体物品。

material: What did the lecturer emphasize about checking sources?
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要同义改写、复合句理解或联系相邻信息，不能只匹配一个关键词。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 The noun 'importance' takes 'of' followed by a gerund phrase.
answer_evidence: 读懂：讲课者强调独立核查资料来源的重要性，不是只要求多收集来源。 解析：the importance of 是“……的重要性”，of 后用 checking sources 表示“核查来源”这件事，不加入干扰块 to。independently 是“独立地”，说明核查方式；参考接受它放 checking 前，也接受放 sources 后，不能断言只有句尾才对。

material: Several first-year students contributed useful ideas at the meeting.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: Which of the ideas is the subject; discussed at the meeting modifies ideas. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：会议讨论过的那些想法中，哪些来自一年级学生？问的是想法的提出者。 解析：Which of the ideas 是要找的“哪些想法”，discussed at the meeting 紧跟它，说明讨论范围；came from first-year students 才是主要动作和来源。did 是干扰，因为这里用“哪些想法”直接作 came 的主角，不是 did 加 came。discussed 也不是本句主要的提问动作。

material: Our workshop begins early on Friday morning.
skills: 疑问句与从句结构 / 词序与语境
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: A modal passive question places 'could' before the subject. The preceding utterance supplies a natural communicative purpose.
answer_evidence: 读懂：研讨会周五一早开始，你问材料能否在活动开始前送达。 解析：Could 放句首表示礼貌询问可能性，the materials 后接 be delivered（被送达），因为材料是被人送来的。are 是多余块，不能写成 could materials are delivered。before the workshop begins 表示“活动开始前”，begins 已固定在句尾，不需要另外加未来词。

material: Explain what you tested instead of repeating the whole experiment.
skills: 句子结构 / 词序与从句
timing_unit: 每份（10 题，10 个小题）
rationale: 需要处理抽象关系、限制条件、隐含态度或更复杂句法，并排除同主题的近似解释。 以给定对话目的限定语义；接受已经逐条审阅的状语位置或从句换序。 The opening phrase contrasts a broad action with a focused alternative.
answer_evidence: 读懂：我们没有重做整个实验，而是只把不确定的那项测量重新测了一次，强调缩小复查范围。 解析：rather than repeat the whole experiment 是“而不是重复整个实验”，整块不可拆。we tested the uncertain measurement 才是实际做的事；again 指重测，可放对象后，参考也接受放 tested 前。对照短语可以在句首或句尾，但不能把它误读成两件事都做了。

material: Your project group reserved a room for a presentation rehearsal. The room’s screen is broken, and your presentation depends on showing visual material to the whole group. You would like the coordinator to help without assuming that any room will meet your needs.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：小组排练展示时发现预订房间的屏幕坏了。写给房间协调员，明确预约与故障、所需设备或房间条件，再提出可行替代方案。 解析：范文说明详细图表需供全组观看，提出六人空间、可晚一小时及借便携投影仪的备选，并给出通知小组所需的回复时间。rehearsal 是“正式展示前的排练”。只要求随便换房会忽略屏幕和容量，不一定解决实际问题。

material: You registered for library training because you need to use its resources for a course project. A required class now takes place at the same time as the training. You do not want to miss the training entirely and can attend at other times.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：图书馆培训与必修课撞时间，但你仍需培训来做课程项目。写信解释冲突、请求其他完成方式，并给出可参加的时段。 解析：范文说明研究数据库培训的重要性，列周三下午及周五上午的空档，再询问其他场次、候补或同等录播教学。availability 是“有空的时间”。只取消原报名或笼统说另找时间，会漏掉继续完成培训和可安排时段。

material: A campus service webpage lists opening hours that do not match the information at the service desk. You relied on the webpage and were unable to complete an important visit. You want the manager to check the discrepancy and prevent similar problems.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：服务网页与柜台开放时间不一致，你据网页跑了一趟却没办成重要事项。写给经理指出冲突、说明影响，并要求确认正确时间及更新信息。 解析：范文对照网页六点、门口四点，再讲五点到达取不到录音机影响周末工作，且用“若门口信息正确”请求改网页，避免未经核实就断言哪方错。discrepancy 是“信息不一致”，不是服务人员故意误导。

material: A guest lecturer presented an idea that may be useful for your class project. You would like to read more, but you are not an expert in the lecturer’s field. A focused request would help the lecturer recommend a source at the right level.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：客座讲座中的一个观点与你的项目有关，你想继续阅读但不是该领域专家。写信提具体观点、联系个人项目，并请求符合自己基础的读物。 解析：范文选城市湿地水流与植被同样重要的观点，联系公园池塘与雨水径流研究，再交代懂基础生态、缺工程知识，求解释术语的入门材料。introductory 是“入门的”。只请推荐好书却不说兴趣和程度，会让对方难选。

material: Your student club is preparing an event and needs additional volunteers. Classmates may be willing to help but do not yet know what the work involves or how much time they would need to give. You are coordinating the invitation.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：社团活动缺志愿者，要向同学说明活动和需帮忙时间、工作职责与准备培训，以及怎样报名和提供什么信息。 解析：范文介绍面向学校学生的科学活动，列指导实验、整理材料和引导访客的职责，说明提供简短培训，再请周三前回复可服务全程或部分时段。sign up 是“报名”。只说欢迎帮忙而不说要做什么、待多久，无法让同学决定。

material: A textbook you ordered has arrived with pages missing. You need the book for your course, so waiting without knowing what will happen is a problem. You have purchase information that will help the bookstore locate your order and resolve the issue.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：新买教材缺页，课程很快要用。写给书店说明缺哪些页与购买信息、为什么须及时处理，并提出换书或其他合适补救。 解析：范文提供缺页范围、订单号和收据照片，说明下周要读该章，提议到校内店取检查过的替换本，并问退回残书的办法。replacement copy 是“替换的一本”。只说书不好或要求道歉，不足以定位订单及解决上课需要。

material: You are considering possible research projects and would like to understand the work of a university laboratory before choosing. You want to ask the supervisor whether a short observation visit would be possible without interfering with the team’s research or safety procedures.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：选研究项目之前，想去相关实验室短暂旁观。给负责人说明兴趣与该实验室的关系、希望了解什么、可用时间，并尊重研究和安全限制。 解析：范文把植物缺水反应与实验室根系研究联系起来，询问观察日常方法和初学者准备，提供两个空档，承诺遵守安全规定并接受部分活动不开放。observe 是“旁观”，不等于获准直接操作实验设备。

material: You have noticed that lights in your residence building remain on at full brightness even when there is substantial daylight. You think a small adjustment might save energy, but you know that safe access must be maintained for everyone using the building.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：宿舍白天采光充足，灯仍全亮。给管理员描述具体位置与观察，提节能调整或试行方案，并说明如何维持安全通行。 解析：范文限定玻璃门厅，建议检查定时或日光传感设置，强调不关楼梯间照明，再试调门厅亮度、收住户反馈。trial 是“试行”，不是直接保证节电且完全无风险。只要求全楼关灯会违背安全条件。

material: Your study group has arranged a meeting, but you can no longer attend. You have already completed part of the work the group expects from you. You want your absence to cause as little difficulty as possible and to stay informed about decisions.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：无法参加已约好的学习小组会议，但你已完成部分任务。写信交代缺席原因、分享自己的成果，并安排补上信息与后续工作。 解析：范文因必修实验延长请假，发送抽样方法笔记和练习题，请同伴批注、发来答案与计划，并提周五短通话补缺。contribution 是“你已做出的那部分工作”。只请人转述会议却不交出完成内容，会让小组仍无法使用你的贡献。

material: Your department is reviewing its orientation program and has asked students for suggestions. Thinking about your own experience, you have identified a change that could help new students. The coordinator wants an idea that can be put into practice with available resources.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：院系征集迎新改进意见。用自己的经历提出一个具体变化，说明它解决新生什么困难，并给出利用现有资源的实施或试验办法。 解析：范文发现听完介绍仍找不到服务地点，于是建议学长带小组实地走四个地点、每站讲使用场景，借现有志愿者和路线图在半小时内完成。orientation 是“新生入门介绍”，不只是迎新表演。只说多办活动不够具体。

material: You are preparing a class project that would benefit from photographs of objects in a museum. You do not know whether the museum permits photography or allows students to include images in coursework. You want permission before making plans for your visit.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：课程项目想拍博物馆物件，但拍摄及在作业中使用图片是否获准都未知。写信说明项目与对象、照片用途，并询问许可和限制。 解析：范文说明家庭用品与地方历史的关系，限定只在课堂展示、不公开商用，再问具体展品限制，提出无闪光、不拍其他访客及获准图片的备选。permission 是“许可”，自称非商业用途不等于自动有权拍摄。

material: A volunteer shift has fewer people available than expected. You are concerned that the remaining volunteers may not be able to complete the work safely and efficiently. You want to alert the coordinator and help find a temporary solution rather than simply complain.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：志愿班次人手不足，可能影响效率和安全。写给协调员说明困难及后果，提一个现实临时办法，并说你能具体帮什么。 解析：范文用两人兼顾整理捐赠和接待导致排队的情况说明压力，建议忙时让早班重叠一小时，自己准备优先任务清单和培训新人。overlap 指“两班部分时间重合”。只批评排班或要求所有人加一整班，不如针对高峰期安排具体。

material: You found a notebook in a seminar room after class. You want to contact the owner through the class mailing list without sharing private contents or making it easy for someone else to claim the notebook. You can keep it safe temporarily.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：你在研讨室捡到笔记本，要通过班级邮件寻找失主，又要保护内容隐私并防止冒领。需给识别特征、验证办法和安全归还安排。 解析：范文公开颜色、带子和找到的位置，却只说有贴纸，不公开贴纸细节，让认领者私下描述；再给本人交还或系办公室代存的办法。confirm 指“确认归属”。若把内部笔记和全部细节广播出去，就失去验证依据。

material: Your course includes a field activity, but one part of the planned route or procedure presents an accessibility barrier for you. You want to participate in the learning rather than simply be excused. Your instructor may be able to arrange an alternative.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：野外课程路线或流程有你无法安全使用的部分。给教师说明相关障碍、请求替代安排，并解释如何仍达到学习目标，不是申请免学。 解析：范文只交代不平整长阶梯的通行困难，提出在可达河段观察流况与土地使用，并用照片和同伴记录补看不能到的部分，再请教师确认符合要求。learning objectives 是“学习目标”；无需透露无关个人病史。

material: You are organizing a student panel and would like to invite a local researcher whose work relates to the topic. The researcher will need to understand the audience, the expected contribution, and the time commitment before deciding whether to take part.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：你想邀本地研究者参加学生座谈。信中须交代主题与听众、希望对方做什么及花多久，并邀请回复、提供更多信息。 解析：范文把听众定为初做独立研究的本科生，邀请研究者用十分钟讲社区交通项目，再参加二十分钟讨论，还交代时间与线上参加可能。panel 是“多人座谈”，不等于请对方独讲整场。只写欢迎莅临不足以让研究者判断投入。

material: While editing a shared project document, you accidentally replaced some of the group’s work. You have begun checking whether earlier versions can be recovered. You want to tell your teammates promptly, take responsibility, and avoid a similar problem during future edits.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：你误覆盖了小组共享文档，已开始查找旧版本。要及时说明经过和受影响内容、汇报或提出恢复步骤，再建议防止重演。 解析：范文直接认错，说明已恢复最近完整稿，但仍请组员核对最后修改，把新文字单独存放后再合并，并建议只改负责段落、重大修订前做备份。version history 是“历史版本”。只道歉不交代恢复状态，或未核对就保证没损失，都不利于协作。

material: Some members of your student club commute and have difficulty attending the current meeting time. Other members have schedules that also need to be considered. You want to propose a fair change to the leader rather than assume one arrangement suits everyone.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：通勤社员难以参加现有会议时间，但其他人也有课。给负责人说明通勤困难、提出具体改时方案，并回应其他成员的顾虑。 解析：范文说明晚会结束赶不上方便的火车，提议隔周提前到六点、保留部分晚场，兼顾下午有课者，并用提前发议程和试行调查检查效果。alternate weeks 是“隔周”，不是所有会议都改。只按自己方便定时间，违背公平考虑。

material: After submitting an application, you noticed that one detail was incorrect. You do not want to submit a second application and create confusion. You have the application information and the correct detail available so the office can advise you.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：已提交的申请有一处信息错误，你不想重复提交造成混乱。写信标明申请与错项、提供正确信息，并问如何办理更正。 解析：范文用姓名与申请编号定位，将原填的最早开始日期与正确日期直接对照，说明其余信息不变，再问办公室可代改还是要走更正表。correction 是“更正”，不是重新申请。只说日期错了却不列正确值，工作人员无法处理。

material: A local organization provided information or assistance for your class project. You have now completed the work and want the organization to know that its contribution was useful. You would also like to share the result without assuming the staff want a large attachment.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：本地机构曾支持课程项目，项目已完成。写信感谢并说明帮助怎样被使用、分享具体成果，再询问是否需要报告或其他跟进，别直接塞大附件。 解析：范文说明志愿者访谈让小组意识到家庭需要灵活时间，因而改进问卷，最终建议保留晚间阅读活动并加提醒系统，再主动提供去除身份信息的报告。outcome 是“具体成果”，不能只说我们完成了项目。

material: A delivery left at your apartment is addressed to someone in another apartment. You have kept the package unopened and want the delivery service to arrange the correction. You cannot remain at home all day waiting for someone to collect it.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：送到你家的包裹实际属于另一公寓，仍未拆封。写给配送服务说明误投和定位信息、请求取回或安全纠正，并提供可行交接时间或方式。 解析：范文对照两个公寓号并给运单号，说明未拆封，提出明早可在家或交有人值守的前台，并请确认后再移交。handover 是“交接”。只说地址错了难定位；让包裹随意放走廊也不符合安全要求。

material: You have prepared an early outline for an essay and would like advice before developing the full draft. Your instructor cannot review every detail at this stage, so you want to identify the part of your argument that most needs clarification.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：论文只有初步提纲，你想在写全文前请教，但教师没时间逐处修改。信中概括论点、指出一个具体疑点，并请求能推进写作的聚焦建议。 解析：范文先说廉价印刷品易丢失，使现存馆藏不能代表过去全部阅读，再指出比较材料范围可能太广，问该聚焦一个城市还是一类印刷品。scope 是“讨论范围”。只附提纲让老师看看，没说明最需要的帮助。

material: The campus café has invited suggestions from its customers. You have noticed a problem that a small change could address without redesigning the whole service. You want to explain who would benefit and propose a manageable way to test your idea.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：咖啡店征集小改进，要求说明改什么、哪些顾客怎样受益，并设计有限试行和评估，不是全面重做服务。 解析：范文建议在菜单旁列三明治配料，帮助有饮食限制的顾客并减少排队询问；先选三款试两周，再问员工是否减少重复问题，配方变时更新。ingredient list 是“配料表”。范文仍让严重过敏者向员工确认，不把简表当安全保证。

material: Your study partner has missed several sessions you arranged together. This has affected your preparation, but you do not know why the sessions were missed. You want to discuss a workable arrangement while keeping the message respectful and open to an explanation.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：学习搭档多次爽约，影响你的准备，但原因未知。写信说明影响、开放询问对方情况，再提出双方可讨论的新安排。 解析：范文具体说在图书馆白等，询问原时间是否仍可行，给较短线上会面及当天互相确认的办法，保留关系而非指责。without making assumptions 是“不先认定原因”。可以体谅忙碌，但不能直接断言对方不重视学习或故意失约。

material: Your department would like to keep a student exhibition open longer than planned, but some of its materials are borrowed. The owner may need them back on the agreed date. You want permission for an extension and are prepared to use an alternative.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：学生展览想延长，但借来的材料原定该还。给物主说明延期原因、新归还日期与保管措施，并提供必须按时还原件时的替代方案。 解析：范文以接待学校团体为由，提出延借地图，继续锁柜和原照明条件；如物主要原件，就按时还并用标明为复制品的材料续展。loan 是“借用”，不是购买。只说展览重要而不谈物主需要和保管，会遗漏关键义务。

material: You missed a scheduled class presentation because you were ill. Your presentation materials are ready, and you would like to complete the work responsibly. You need to ask the instructor about another opportunity without assuming that the original assessment requirements will be waived.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：因病错过已排定的课堂展示，材料已准备好。给教师简述缺席、提出补做时间或方式，并问如何达到与同学相同的要求。 解析：范文提出下次课开头或办公时间展示，特别询问问答环节如何补齐，愿先发幻灯片并提供规定的证明。make-up presentation 是“补做展示”。只求交幻灯片代替全部考核，可能漏掉展示和问答要求；不要默认因病就免除它们。

material: Your project group is preparing a survey for other students. One draft question combines ideas that respondents might evaluate differently, so a single answer may be hard to interpret. You want to raise the concern before the survey is distributed.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：问卷一道题把可能被不同评价的两个想法混在一起。给组员指出哪题与解释问题、建议清晰改写，并提发放前的小检查。 解析：范文把公交“便宜且可靠”拆开：受访者可能认同价格却不认同准时，单一答案无法解释，于是分问可负担程度和准点情况，再找三位同学试答。wording 是“措辞”。只说问题太长而没拆清含义，未解决核心。

material: You registered for a seminar, but the confirmation message lists a different session from the one you selected. The listed session conflicts with another commitment. You want the organizer to check your registration and help you find a workable arrangement.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：研讨会确认信列错场次，新列时段与你的安排冲突。写信定位报名、说明原选场次与时间限制，请求纠正并询问必要的备选。 解析：范文给确认号和报名日期，对照原选上午、收到下午，说明必修课冲突，再求恢复上午或候补及之后同等场次。confirmation 是“确认通知”，不是必须接受的不可更改结果。只要求取消会偏离仍希望完成培训的目的。

material: Several students would like to run a short peer workshop on a skill useful for their coursework. You are willing to help organize it, but you need departmental permission to use a suitable room. The department will want to know how the session will be managed.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：学生想办短时同伴技能工作坊，需要院系批准房间。写明主题与对象、所需场地时间，并说明怎样负责任地组织。 解析：范文以整理研究引用为主题，请一小时机房，限制十二人、提前发准备说明、用后复原，并说明只是补充图书馆正式培训，复杂问题交工作人员。peer workshop 是“同学之间带领的练习课”。只报活动名称不说明管理，很难获批。

material: While reviewing a class handout, you notice a possible error in one example. You may have misunderstood the explanation, so you want to ask rather than simply announce that the material is wrong. The example matters for an assignment you are preparing.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：课堂讲义例子可能有错，也可能是你误解。写信定位问题、说明自己的推理，并求澄清或更正以继续完成作业。 解析：范文指出表格百分比合计为一百一十，而文字像在说互不重叠的组别，于是问是笔误还是可以多选，而非断言教师算错。mutually exclusive 是“不能同时属于两个类别”。如果类别可重叠，总和超百本身未必错误。

material: Your local library has invited ideas for community events. You have an activity in mind that would interest a particular audience and could use the library’s resources. The events team needs enough information to judge whether the proposal is practical.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：向本地图书馆提社区活动，须说明面向谁、目的是什么、参与者具体做什么，以及所需物资和组织支持。 解析：范文让青少年及成人比较不同时代的社区地图，讨论道路和地名变化；列会议室、复制地图、投影仪，并由写信人与员工共同带领。reproductions 是“复制品”，能便于标注又保护原件。只报活动名或泛说增进交流，无法判断可行性。

material: Repair work in your residence building has been noisy while you are preparing for an online examination. You know the work may be necessary, but you need to plan a period of uninterrupted practice. The housing office may be able to suggest an arrangement.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：宿舍维修噪声影响线上考试准备，但维修可能必要。写给住宿办公室说明冲突、询问施工安排，并请求能安心练习的实际办法。 解析：范文给出听力练习的具体一小时，先问是否会钻孔，再提若不能暂停可借安静房间，自带电脑耳机，只需桌子和稳定网络。uninterrupted 是“不受打断的”。只要求整项工程停工，没有考虑维修需要，也没提供可协调条件。

material: You are doing a student project and believe a local organization may already collect useful information. You do not need personal records, and you want to avoid creating unnecessary work for its staff. You would like to request suitable data respectfully.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：课程项目想借用本地机构已有信息，但不需要个人档案，也不想增加工作人员负担。说明项目和所需数据、排除身份信息，并愿署明来源、分享有用结果。 解析：范文请求已有的全年每月花园访问总数，用于季节比较，明确不要姓名或个人签到，接受计数方法等限制，愿回传简报。non-identifying data 是“不含可识别个人信息的数据”。不能只说研究用途就索取全部记录。

material: You would like to review course material with a classmate before an upcoming quiz. A focused session could help both of you identify gaps, but you have not yet agreed on a plan. You want to suggest a practical arrangement and preparation.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：测验前邀请同学一起复习，要交代目标、可协调的时间地点，以及双方各准备什么，不能只是问一起学习吗。 解析：范文提出一小时生态复习，各带三道需解释的问题，轮流脱稿回答后查书补缺，并分担植物土壤与传粉主题，允许改约周末。prepare 指“提前准备”。只定见面地点却没有分工，可能让会面缺少重点。

material: You registered for a conference and noticed that the fee appears twice in your payment record. You intended to register only once. Registration support will need enough information to locate both charges without confusing your request with a cancellation.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：会议报名费似乎被扣了两次，你只报一次而仍要参加。给支持人员说明重复记录与报名信息、提供支付线索，并请求纠正且保留名额。 解析：范文给报名号、两笔金额和相近时间，提供遮去无关信息的收据，请核实后退重复款，明确不取消会议和海报展示。duplicate charge 是“重复扣费”，不等于要求退全部费用。漏说继续参会，容易造成误会。

material: Visitors often seem confused at a particular point inside a campus building. You have noticed that the signs do not clearly show where an important service or room is located. You want facilities staff to consider a specific improvement to the directions.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：校内建筑某处分流指示不清，访客找不到重要服务。写给设施团队定位困惑点、说明谁怎样迷路，并提出清楚且放对位置的标牌。 解析：范文说明语言中心接待台在转角下层，新生见走廊空就以为无人值守，建议门对面和电梯旁设方向牌、标无障碍路线，先用临时纸牌试位置与措辞。directional sign 是“方向指示牌”。只写多加标牌，不说明去哪和放哪，难执行。

material: Your group project has reached a stage where the existing division of work no longer seems balanced. You want to discuss a change before the deadline becomes a problem. Your teammates may have different schedules and strengths, so agreement is important.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：项目当前分工已不均衡，需在临近截止前与队友商量。信中指出担忧、提出具体公平分配，并邀请按各人时间与长处调整。 解析：范文说明数据分析比引言和排版耗时，单人负责会成进度瓶颈，建议拆成核查数据与解释结果，自己承担表格核查，最后全组复审其他工作。bottleneck 是“拖住整体进度的瓶颈”。公平不是每人任务名称数量一样。

material: A mentor recently gave you advice before an interview. You have now had an opportunity to use that advice and want to explain how it helped. You would also like to keep the mentor informed about what you plan to do next.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：导师曾给面试建议，你已实践。写信感谢并点明建议、说明怎样使用和产生什么效果，再交代下一步计划。 解析：范文把每项能力配具体例子的建议用于讲小组补救错过截止日的经历，比只说善合作更清楚；结果是能回答追问，而不是宣称已拿到实习，随后计划计时练更简短的开头。follow-up question 是“追问”。只感谢有帮助会显得空泛。

material: An educational video assigned in your course is difficult for you to follow without captions. You want to complete the learning task, not avoid it. The course team may be able to add captions or provide another resource that preserves the important content.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：课程视频没有字幕很难跟上，但你仍想完成学习。给课程团队说明困难、请求字幕或适当支持，并提字幕暂时做不出时的替代材料。 解析：范文说声音弱、术语不熟，求字幕或核查过的文字稿，暂时可给幻灯片与词表，并愿标出听不清的时间点。captions 是“视频字幕”，transcript 是“文字稿”。只要求免看视频就失去保留学习内容的目的。

material: Your class would benefit from seeing how work is carried out in a local organization. You would like to ask the manager about a short visit, but you understand that visitors could interrupt normal operations. Your proposal should be limited and practical.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：班级想短访本地机构了解实际工作，又不能干扰营业。写给经理说明学习目的、人数时长等有限安排，并表示尊重限制和愿协调。 解析：范文以六名学生了解自行车零件维修判断为目标，只求安静时段二十分钟讲解，不观察顾客、不未经许可拍照，若不便则线上交流。operational constraints 是“日常运营限制”。不能只说参观有趣却默认可自由进出工作区。

material: You have discovered that two courses required for your program overlap in the timetable. You need both courses to make progress, but you cannot attend both as currently scheduled. Your adviser may know about alternative sections or other acceptable arrangements.
skills: 沟通目的与语域 / 组织与具体细节
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Coordinate a realistic situation, recipient-appropriate tone, and three requested communicative actions within the existing seven-minute task.
answer_evidence: 读懂：两门必修课同时上，都会影响学业进度。写给导师列课程与冲突、说明对学习计划的后果，并询问其他班次或下一步程序。 解析：范文具体说统计辅导课与环境方法实验同在周四上午，缺席会影响实践任务；已查到另一班满员，所以问候补、调课或联系负责人。overlap 是“时间重叠”。交替翘课并不能自然满足两门要求，也不应直接要求免修。

material: Professor: Students sometimes propose small research projects that fall outside their regular coursework. A university is considering a fund for these projects and must decide whether supporting beginners is a good use of a limited research budget. Should universities offer small grants for student-led research?
skills: 立场与论证 / 回应不同观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: Evaluate two developed, distinct arguments and add a supported contribution. The original question and the students' positions are retained.
answer_evidence: 读懂：有限研究经费是否应拨小额资助给学生自发项目？争论是初学者的实践学习价值与成熟研究的资金需要。 解析：范文有条件支持，以校园交通调查的问卷和计数说明小额钱能支持真实方法练习，再要求基本指导与公开短报告，强调说明局限，而非保证新手一定产出突破。student-led 是“学生主导的”。反对分散资金也可论证，不能只说研究重要。

material: Professor: A city is considering restricting cars on streets immediately beside schools. The proposal aims to change conditions when children arrive and leave, but the same streets are also used by residents, deliveries, and people traveling elsewhere. Should cities introduce car-free streets near schools?
skills: 立场与论证 / 回应不同观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）

skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通

material: You coordinate school visits at an animal shelter. A teacher asks for a large class to hold and feed the animals during a one-hour visit. Your shelter allows visitors to observe, but animal handling is reserved for trained volunteers.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通

material: Your community orchestra conductor has asked you to cover a difficult solo after another player withdrew. The concert is in five days. You can play the ensemble part confidently but cannot prepare the solo to a reliable standard in that time.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通

material: You borrowed a key to your colleague’s home to water plants while the colleague traveled. You are ready to return it, but your colleague suggests leaving it under the outside mat because your schedules do not overlap. You are uncomfortable with that method.

answer_evidence: 范文提供办公室直接交还或经主人确认的可信代收人，未确认前自己保管；不能擅自把“认识的人”当作获授权代收。

material: You ordered reusable cups for a university reunion. The supplier printed last year’s date instead of the date shown on your approved design. The cups are otherwise usable, and the event is next week. You want a remedy without automatically discarding them.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: remedy 是补救；同时顾及日期、下周时限和减少浪费。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文先问现有杯能否耐久更正，不自行保证贴纸适用；不可行再询换货、退回及费用。只要折扣未必解决错误纪念日期。

material: You are hosting a visiting classmate for an afternoon. They arrive at 1 p.m. and must leave at 6 p.m. They hope to visit the local history museum, which closes at 4 p.m., and walk a riverside trail that takes about seventy-five minutes. The museum and trail entrance are ten minutes apart on foot.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: sequence 是活动顺序；博物馆关门是硬时间，散步长度可以调整。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文先两小时博物馆、步行十分钟再走河边，余时留休息和出发；不是把六点前每分钟塞满，还问偏好以决定取舍。

material: A local newspaper interviewed you about a student river-monitoring project. Its draft says, “The river is safe for swimming,” but you said your group measured water clarity only and did not test swimming safety. The journalist has sent the draft for factual checking before publication.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: clarity 是清澈度，不等于 swimming safety（游泳安全）。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文指出测量边界，给替换句并显式排除安全结论；把“安全”改成“看起来安全”仍超出证据范围。

material: You chair a student cultural fair. A social-media post claims the whole fair is canceled because one dance group withdrew. The rest of the program is still planned, and you are arranging a replacement for that performance. Write to club representatives who are receiving questions.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）

material: You lead a youth art workshop. A parent has requested that their child not appear in promotional photographs. Your photographer suggests seating the child away from the group for the entire session. You want to respect the request without excluding the child from the activity.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: publicity 是宣传；不授权拍照不是不允许孩子参加活动。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文用作品近照与自愿拍照时段，给不入镜者持续活动，发布前对许可表；单靠裁脸或整场隔离都未充分解决问题。

material: Your residents’ association surveyed neighborhood priorities through an online form. Most replies came from one apartment block, while residents without reliable internet were not reached. The chair wants to call the results “the whole neighborhood’s priorities.” You helped collect the responses.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: responded 是作答者，不等于全体居民；要解释覆盖缺口而非否定已有回复。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文提出纸表和其他楼栋收集点，暂称“回复者的优先事项”并披露分布；增加同一楼更多回复不能弥补覆盖偏差。

material: You have received an internship offer from a small design studio. The offer says two days per week, but a later message mentions evening client events without saying whether they replace those days or are additional. You must decide whether to accept by Friday.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: additional 是额外增加；题目需要澄清总投入，不是简单问几点上班。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文问计入方式、频率、通知期，并用课业说明决定所需信息；未确认就接受，再把晚间活动一概拒绝会埋下冲突。

material: Your coworker has prepared a spreadsheet tool that deletes customer records with identical names. You notice two different customers named Maria Santos with different account numbers. The tool has not been run on the main file. Write to your coworker before the planned cleanup.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: identical names 是同名，不等于同一客户；要保护有效记录。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文用不同账号反证，先在副本测试并把冲突转人工；只多检查几个姓名仍没修正匹配规则，也不能直接在主文件试删。

material: Your book club includes members reading at different speeds. At recent meetings, people who had finished the novel revealed the ending during the opening discussion. A member suggests banning anyone who has not finished from attending. You organize the meetings.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: spoilers 是提前泄露情节；要兼顾深入讨论与尚未读完者的参与。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文按章节范围分段，提前标明转场并留退出选择；只喊“别剧透”仍让主持人和成员无法判断何时可谈结局。

material: You captain a recreational volleyball team. A teammate returning after an absence wants to play the entire next match, but they have told you they are following a gradual return plan from their clinician. You are not qualified to judge their medical readiness.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: gradual return 是逐步恢复参与；队长不能替专业人员判断能打多久。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文欢迎但不施压，只要安排所需限制、不索私人病情，并给记录轮转等角色；说“少打一局肯定没事”仍属越权保证。

material: Your instructor gave feedback that your presentation explained results clearly but did not show how you collected the data. Your data came from a short questionnaire completed by classmates. You have revised the slides to add a short methods section, removing two repeated examples of the same result to keep the original presentation time. Write to the instructor before a practice session.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: methods 是研究方法；感谢要连接具体修改，不是泛称建议有帮助。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文补参与者与记录方式，删重复例子守住时限，只问抽样局限讲清否；要求老师全面重审会偏离聚焦反馈。

material: Your roommate is preparing food for a family celebration and asks to use most of the refrigerator for two days. The refrigerator has three main shelves and door compartments. You also need space for your regular meals. You want to help without discovering later that your food has been moved or discarded.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: allocation 是分配；支持聚会不等于让出全部日常需要。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文给上两层与下层加门格的具体分法，设恢复时点，并约定动别人食物前问；“随便用”容易与后续边界冲突。

material: You and a classmate are reviewing another student’s essay for a peer-feedback exercise. Your partner’s draft comments call the writer “lazy,” although the actual problems are missing evidence and unclear paragraph connections. Write privately to your partner before feedback is sent.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: lazy 是对人的评价；缺证据只证明文章问题，不能证明没努力。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文把攻击转成定位段落、补例子、加逻辑衔接，最后逐条检查可修改性；只换成“写得不好”仍无教学价值。

material: Your history assignment asks you to analyze a firsthand source. You planned to examine a local museum diary, but the museum has closed its reading room for repairs. A digitized collection of letters from the same period is available through your library, including descriptions of the writers’ daily work. You want to keep the original deadline.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: firsthand source 是当事人的一手材料；任务变来源，不变截止日或分析目标。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文用同期书信保留一手分析，提出收信人影响并问数字版本局限；改用现代概述会改变材料性质。

material: You are moving across town and want to reuse packing boxes rather than buy new ones. A neighbor recently moved in and posted that clean boxes are available, but asked that collection not disrupt their work from home. Write to arrange a considerate pickup.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: collection 是取物；须兼顾需要、工作时间和赠出后的约定。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文说明中号箱用途，让邻居定短时段或同意的取物点，再问箱底与归还意愿；“随时来”不尊重远程工作限制。

material: You will introduce student award recipients at a ceremony. You are unsure how to pronounce one recipient’s name, and the printed list contains only its written form. You know the recipient through a class and want to ask respectfully before the event.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通

answer_evidence: 范文给当面或语音选择，问重音及希望公布的名字形式，限定录音用途；不能把练习用录音直接当典礼素材播放。

material: You serve on a neighborhood committee. The draft minutes say a new parking plan was unanimously approved, but you and another member voted against it because delivery access was unresolved. The plan did receive a majority vote. Write to the committee secretary.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: unanimously 是一致通过，majority 是多数；更正记录不等于推翻结果。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文承认决议有效，要求记两票反对及送货通道顾虑，并可与主席核对；长篇重辩停车方案会偏离秘书的记录职责。

material: You belong to a neighborhood time bank, where members exchange hours of help. You spent an hour preparing materials for a member’s workshop before the member canceled it. The rules explain completed sessions but do not address preparation time. Write to the coordinator, not the canceling member.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: credit 是时数记账，不是现金赔偿；规则未覆盖准备工作，不能先认定欠款。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。

material: You are selecting packaging for your student-run shop. A supplier advertises a container as “eco-friendly” but gives no details about its materials or how customers should dispose of it. Your campus accepts only certain packaging types in its recycling bins.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）

material: You bought a block of concert tickets for your friends. One friend, Max, can no longer attend and asks you to promise a refund immediately. The organizer permits ticket transfers but says refunds are available only if the concert is canceled. The concert is still going ahead.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）

material: You attended a new-members evening at a local museum. skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通

answer_evidence: 范文先讲策展人分享价值，再指出不会报名和加入志愿项目，给末尾五分钟及信息台；仅要求“更多互动”未对准困惑。

material: You agreed to judge a student photography contest. After receiving the entries, you recognize one photograph as your cousin’s work, even though the entries use numbers rather than names. You have not scored any entry yet. Write to the contest organizer.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）

material: You are joining a beginner’s knitting class at a community center. You are left-handed, and the course description says demonstrations will be shown from a right-handed perspective. You do not need a separate class but want to know how to follow the demonstrations.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: perspective 是观察角度；提出学习需要，不先认定左右手必须分班。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
