material: You coordinate a neighborhood street meal. Volunteers want to place tables across the only walkway to several homes to create a long shared table. Residents must still be able to reach their front doors throughout the event. Write to the table-layout volunteer.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: continuous path 是连续通路；不是只有入口留一个空隙就够。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文保留社交目标、改成单侧短桌，并检查坐人后椅子外伸；只量空桌间距可能活动开始才堵住住户出入。

material: Your student café runs a pay-it-forward program: customers buy extra drink vouchers for other students. Staff currently call out recipients’ names and announce that their drinks were donated. A student has privately said this feels embarrassing. The café already uses order numbers for other purchases. You coordinate the program.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: discreet 是不张扬；隐私改进不能顺带丢掉代金券核销记录。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文不泄露投诉者，用普通订单号取饮品、内部记券号，之后对账；把所有记录取消虽低调，却无法核实项目使用。

material: You are co-hosting an online seminar on September 30 at 10:00 UTC, which is 18:00 in the guest speaker’s UTC+8 location. The original invitation said only “10:00,” without a time zone. The speaker can attend the intended slot but asks for clarification. The plan is a twenty-minute presentation and fifteen minutes of moderated questions.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: time zone 是时区；必须让双方确认同一时刻，而非只保证以后补说明。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文给九月三十日UTC十点与嘉宾当地十八点，补日历并请核对，再说明二十分钟报告、十五分钟主持问答；不可只写“上午十点”。

material: Your student association voted to hold a consultation meeting at 8 p.m. Most voters live on campus, while commuter representatives have explained that their last bus leaves earlier. You helped run the poll and want the chair to reconsider how commuters can participate.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: consultation 是征求意见；多数人的方便不能证明其他群体能参与。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文说明末班车障碍，提出早场或书面通道，关键是决定前纳入讨论；会后才收建议只是形式补救。

material: You borrowed a family friend’s old wooden picture frame for a theater display. During packing, a corner was scratched. The frame has sentimental value, and you have not tried to repair it. Write to the owner before returning it.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: sentimental value 是情感价值；赔礼不等于自行决定修复方法。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文明确划伤及责任，不试涂盖，先给照片、商量专业修复并承担合理费用；直接买新框无法替代原物意义。

material: You are taking over as treasurer of a student club. The outgoing treasurer offers to send their personal email password because the club’s payment account uses that address. You want continuity without taking control of the former officer’s private messages.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: handover 是交接职责，不是接管前任私人邮箱。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文拒收个人密码，按服务商流程换社团联系地址，再核余额、待付款和周期扣费；只有能登录不代表账目交接完成。

material: Your community center has invited residents to contribute objects for a temporary “Everyday History” display. You own an old bus pass from your first job and would like to lend it, not donate it permanently. Write to the exhibition organizer.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: loan 是借展，donation 是捐赠；物件价值可来自日常经历而非名贵。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文用第一份工作的通勤故事解释关联，明确临时借出，再问纸品保护、署名和归还；只介绍故事会漏掉所有权与返还安排。

material: You coordinate celebrations for a small office. A coworker has quietly told you they dislike surprise parties and public birthday announcements. Another colleague has already begun planning a surprise lunch for them. Write privately to that colleague.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: surprise 是惊喜安排，但对方明确不喜欢，善意不能替代其偏好。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文提私下卡片和事先询问的小聚，不把拒绝理由广播给全体；规模缩小但仍突袭，不一定尊重原请求。

material: Your course lists the third edition of a textbook, but you already own the second edition. The bookstore says both cover the main topics, while page numbers and exercises differ. You want to ask your instructor whether you can use the older copy without missing required work.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: edition 是版本；主题相似不保证题号和作业内容相同。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文问哪些任务依赖新版，拟用旧版通读，并先查图书馆是否有新版可核指定练习；记录内容差异，不能只对页码或默认一定有书可借。

material: You coordinate a new peer-mentoring program with twelve first-year students and six volunteer mentors. A partner coordinator suggests assigning two students to each mentor immediately, but you have not collected students’ goals or mentors’ availability. You want a thoughtful matching process.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: matching 是配对；人数平均不等于目标和时间匹配。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文先收目标、可用时段，再见面试配并私下复查；把调整称为试行机制能避免学生为怕得罪导师而不反映问题。

material: You hired a photographer for a student conference. The agreement includes twenty edited images, but your committee now asks for every unedited file as well. The committee wants to document small-group sessions as well as the main presentations. You are the contact person and want to explore options without treating extra work as already included.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: deliverables 是约定交付物；新增需求不能写成摄影师原本就欠交。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文先认二十张精修，解释小组活动用途并开放更多精修的替代，问费用、时间及使用条件；先承诺加购再问委员会会越权。

material: Your friend has asked you to review a speech they will give at your birthday dinner. It includes a humorous story about your unsuccessful audition that you do not want shared with the guests. You both enjoy remembering how you got lost on your first campus tour. You appreciate the effort and want to suggest that story instead.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: omitted 是被省略掉的；设定隐私边界不必指责朋友想羞辱自己。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文点名试镜失败故事，说明不想公开，换共同迷路趣事，且无需向客人解释删改；含糊说“别太尴尬”不够可执行。

material: A coworker uses keyboard shortcuts to process routine spreadsheet reports much faster than you do. They have offered to help, but you do not want to interrupt them repeatedly during deadlines. Write to arrange a short, focused learning session.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: focused 是聚焦；请求同事帮助要具体且可控，不是无限次随时教学。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文锁定跳转与重复格式，备示例数据、约二十分钟，之后自写清单练习；只说“教我Excel”会扩大对方负担。

material: You found a USB drive beside the workshop tables after yesterday’s session at the community center. A message in the event group asks whoever found it to open the files and identify the owner. You have not connected the drive to a computer. Write to the center’s front-desk supervisor.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: claimant 是来认领的人；找失主不代表获准浏览文件。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文未连接设备，交前台失物流程，用外观和使用地点核身份，群里仅报失物；公开截图找主人反而扩散私人内容。

material: Your art instructor wants to display students’ early sketches beside finished work to show the creative process. You are willing to participate, but your sketchbook pages include private notes unrelated to the project. Write before the instructor collects the books.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: creative process 是创作过程；展示真实发展不需要公开整本私人笔记。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文选能显示构图变化的扫描页、仅遮无关私记，交老师先看；只交精修后的新草图会把真实过程伪装成展示稿。

material: You help run a beginner chess tournament at a community center. Some new players leave after losing their first match because they assume they are eliminated. The event actually guarantees everyone three games, regardless of results. Write to the volunteer handling announcements.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: eliminated 是被淘汰；本赛制保证三盘，不由第一盘输赢决定。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文把留场、查配对和等待位置连成动作，再询新手输棋后会怎么做验证理解；重复“三轮制”术语不一定消除误会。

material: You will demonstrate a student-built website at a public showcase. The organizer says the venue’s internet may be unreliable. Your team’s live demonstration normally needs a connection, but you can prepare a recorded walkthrough and local screenshots. Write to your teammate who is presenting with you.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: backup 是备用方案，不表示提前宣布演示必然失败。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文在网络稳定时仍做现场演示，备录屏与本地截图并明确标注，约定一次失败即切换；不能把录制过程冒充现场功能。

material: You organize a community clothing swap. A volunteer has proposed sorting clothes into “normal sizes” and “large sizes.” Items come from different brands, so size labels vary, and you want shoppers to feel welcome rather than judged. Write to the sorting volunteer.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: normal sizes 暗含某些体型不正常；品牌尺码差异也让该分类不实用。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文按衣物种类、原尺码及缺标时的实测尺寸组织，再模拟找衣服；只把“正常”换“普通”仍可能保留评判。

material: You volunteer as a campus buddy for incoming students. Your assigned student, Luis, has said the welcome email contains too many links and that they do not know where to begin. They arrive next week and have already arranged housing.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: priority 是先后重点；对方缺的是起步顺序，不是更多链接。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文跳过已办住房，按账户、学生卡、迎新安排排序，再只问一个最急问题；把所有资源重发会增加同样负担。

material: You are co-chairing a volunteer committee meeting scheduled for one hour. The draft agenda includes twelve routine updates and two decisions needed that evening. Your co-chair wants every update read aloud, but you are concerned the decisions will be rushed.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: routine updates 是例行通报，不等于需要讨论的决策。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文把通报提前发、留十分钟问变动，两项各二十分钟、末十分钟分工，总计一小时；单纯要求大家讲快点没有保护决策时间。

material: You organized a restaurant dinner for six friends. Before booking, two friends said they wanted to pay only for what they ordered because their budgets were tight. You agreed to individual payment before making the booking. Another friend now suggests splitting the total equally for convenience. You want to settle the arrangement before dinner.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: equally 是均分，不一定符合此前按个人点单支付的约定。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文不公开朋友预算，先问分账、再记录个人及自选共享项，并预先讨论服务费；到结账才谈会让人难以拒绝。

material: Your neighbor walks your dog once a week. During a recent walk together, your dog stopped repeatedly and tried to turn back near a crowded street market. Your neighbor usually takes that route because it is convenient. A quieter path around the playing field is available but less direct. You want to request a quieter route without diagnosing the dog’s behavior.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: tried to turn back 是试图往回走；应写观察到的停步回头，不擅自诊断病因。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文请求绕安静球场、可缩短其他路段避免加时，并问可行性；“你必须让它习惯”既超出证据又增加邻居责任。

material: You want to enter a community art contest with a digitally created illustration printed on paper. The entry form allows “original artwork,” while an older information sheet says “handmade entries only.” Entries close next Friday, and you have not paid the fee.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: original 是原创，handmade 是手工；纸上成品不自动解决制作方式限制。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文并列现旧措辞，说明数字创作后打印，问有效规则及原创证明；不能把“我自己做的”当作规则已经允许。

material: Your three-person class team is building a study planner. With one week left, a teammate proposes adding a social chat feature, while the required calendar and reminder functions still need testing. You want to preserve the teammate’s idea without risking an incomplete submission.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: required 是必须交付；新功能有价值不代表现在值得加入。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文先认可协作价值，把聊天记为未来扩展及草图，不冒充已实现；先承诺聊天再赌测试够快会使必要功能失守。

material: You tested a museum’s new audio guide as a volunteer. The narrator’s speech is clear when heard alone, but the background music makes some object descriptions hard to follow. The audio producer has asked for specific feedback before release.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: balance 是声音比例；问题在配乐与人声竞争，不是口音或讲者能力。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文保留转场音乐、讲述时降低，并用同设备对比及复述测理解；只问“好不好听”测不到内容是否听清。

material: You meet a language-exchange partner weekly to practice English and Mandarin. Recently, nearly the whole hour has been spent on your partner’s English practice, leaving little time for your Mandarin questions. You value the friendship and want a more reciprocal arrangement.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: reciprocal 是互相受益；要说时间分配事实，不猜对方故意占便宜。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文各二十五分钟、轮换先后并双方带问题，给调整空间；固定把自己的语言排末尾仍容易被超时挤掉。

material: You coordinate volunteers at a weekend festival. A volunteer reports finishing a shift but says no supervisor was available to sign their hours sheet. Your records show the volunteer checked in, but you still need confirmation of the work period before issuing a participation letter.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: sign-off 是负责人确认；签到只证明到场，不证明全部服务时长。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文承认流程缺口，要岗位、结束时间和同组成员，自己找负责人核实后发信；直接按自报时数证明或让志愿者重跑全流程都不妥。

material: Your backyard tree has produced more apples than your household can use. You would like to offer some to a neighbor who coordinates a community cooking group. Some apples have marks on their skin. You can provide one collection this week but cannot promise a regular supply.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: one collection 是本周一次领取，不是长期供货承诺。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文说明一次性与外观瑕疵，让料理组按用途查看自选、带容器，先问计划是否需要；不能替对方保证所有果实质量或稳定数量。

material: A colleague wants to try cycling to work and has asked to join your commute. Your usual route includes a steep hill, while a flatter route takes longer. Your colleague has not described their cycling experience. Write to plan a first ride without assuming their abilities.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: flatter 是坡度更缓，不等于更短；先了解经验和到达约束。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文把两路差异说清，问近期骑行及时间，提宽裕日慢骑或先探部分路线；“跟紧我就行”把同事能力默认成自己水平。

material: You are helping create a neighborhood history map. An old source uses street names that are no longer current. The designer plans to replace every old name with its modern equivalent, but some changes are uncertain and visitors also need to understand the historical record.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: equivalent 是对应名称；现名替换会掩盖尚未证实的对应关系。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文保留历史层原名，只给核实者括注现名，未定者明示，再逐项找档案核对；看起来整齐不应以伪确定性换取。

material: Your roommate has twice borrowed your noise-canceling headphones without asking. You use them for online tutoring appointments and could not find them before one session. You are willing to lend them occasionally, but need a clear agreement.

material: You co-wrote a popular online guide to using a campus software service. The service has changed its menu, and readers now report that your old instructions lead to the wrong settings page. Your coauthor wants to wait until next term for a complete rewrite.

material: In your four-person class team, you have taken notes and sent follow-up messages at every meeting. The others do most of the presentation speaking. You want to practice presenting too, but the administrative tasks still need to be done. Write to the whole team before the next meeting.

material: You are ordering uniforms for a recreational team. The supplier’s size chart lists only “small,” “medium,” and “large,” with no measurements. The team must submit one group order, and exchanges are limited. You want to avoid asking members to guess.

material: Your cousin will stay with you for three days during your examination week. You are happy to host, but your cousin has sent a full sightseeing plan that assumes you can accompany them all day. You can share evenings after studying, not daytime outings.

material: You organize an amateur astronomy evening. The forecast provided by the venue predicts heavy cloud, but the event can use an indoor room. Tickets advertised “a chance to observe the night sky,” not guaranteed views. Write to registered participants before they travel.

material: Your neighborhood association is preparing a memorial notice for a long-serving volunteer. You have been asked to write it, but the family has not approved the wording or said whether they want funeral details published. Write sensitively to the family’s designated contact.

material: You tested a new student-made quiz app and found that the explanation screen displays the correct reasoning, but the final review labels the same response wrong. You can reproduce this using a practice account. Write to the student developer with useful evidence, not a general complaint.

material: You are planning a student club’s annual meeting. The nomination form assumes every member can attend in person to stand for a committee role. material: Your graduating class plans to seal letters in a time capsule and open it at a reunion ten years later. The organizer proposes reading every letter aloud at that reunion, but contributors have not been told this. You are helping collect the letters.

material: Professor: A college is reconsidering how teachers mark essays. material: Professor: A large museum is considering lending important objects to smaller museums in nearby towns. material: Professor: A film club is discussing adaptations of well known novels. material: Professor: A local sports league is considering using video replays to review disputed decisions during games. Should the league introduce replays, or continue relying on the officials' decisions made during the game?

material: Professor: A community sports club welcomes adults with very different experience levels. material: Professor: A community center runs an afternoon play session for children. Staff can organize a sequence of games with rules or provide approved materials for children to invent their own activities under supervision. Parents want the session to be enjoyable and worthwhile. material: Professor: A town funds a community choir that performs at several public celebrations each year. The conductor proposes auditions because rehearsal time is limited and the concerts should sound polished. Other members believe anyone who wants to sing should be welcome. timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）

material: Professor: An adult photography course currently gives every learner the same weekly assignment. skills: 区分学习目标与题材 / 构造可比较的例证
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: personal projects 是个人选题项目；争点是贴近兴趣与便于比较学习效果。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。

material: Professor: A neighborhood tool library lends equipment that residents use only occasionally. Volunteers are deciding whether to spend their small training budget on more written instructions or on short practical introductions for first-time borrowers. Existing safety restrictions would apply in either case. Which form of support should receive priority, and why?
skills: 比较支持方式 / 用可观察行为检验理解
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）

answer_evidence: 范文新增让借用者复述并指出控件的检查，用缝纫机作假设例子，说明点头不等于懂；简明说明卡延续同一内容，也不把入门课当成解除安全限制的许可。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A volunteer reading club has been organized by the same person for several years. Members value the organizer's experience, but no one else knows all the booking and planning routines. The club is considering rotating the role each term. Should leadership rotate regularly, or remain with the person who performs it well?
skills: 解释组织连续性 / 以具体交接步骤支持观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: rotating the role 是轮流担任组织者；要权衡经验带来的稳定与职责、知识的传承。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。

material: Professor: A town has set aside a small budget for one neighborhood improvement. Residents can propose projects, but officials must choose among ideas that serve different numbers of people and have different maintenance needs. Should the final choice be made by a public vote or by a panel that compares the proposals using published criteria?
skills: 分解集体决策阶段 / 解释长期成本与参与边界
vocabulary: public vote / maintenance needs / paper ballots
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: published criteria 是公开的评选标准；争点是居民决定权与项目后续是否养得起。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。

material: Professor: A town can use this year's tree budget either to plant trees on several streets that have none or to improve the care of trees planted during the previous two years. Some recent plantings are struggling, and staff cannot fully fund both options. Which use of the budget should take priority?
skills: 比较维护与扩张 / 用长期成果限定评价
vocabulary: recent plantings / care plan / planting totals
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: care of trees 是树木养护；要权衡尚未受益街道的公平与已有树木能否存活。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。

material: Professor: A public park has several open lawns. Its managers propose leaving part of one lawn unmown for most of the year so residents can observe a less managed growing area. Others want every lawn kept short for games and informal gatherings. How should the park balance these different uses of limited open space?
skills: 识别空间用途差异 / 设计兼顾得失的试行
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: unmown 是不修剪的；题目权衡观察自然生长与保留可实际活动的草坪。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。

material: Professor: A popular walking trail becomes crowded on a few holiday mornings but is quiet on most other days. The park is considering requiring advance reservations for all visits throughout the year. Managers want predictable visitor numbers, while residents value spontaneous walks. Would a year-round reservation system be an appropriate response to this problem?
skills: 区分问题成因 / 限定政策适用时段
vocabulary: advance reservations / arrival windows / peak periods
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: year-round 是全年；题目权衡管理可预测性与淡时段随时散步的便利。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。

material: Professor: A community garden has space for either small plots assigned to individual households or larger beds that members care for together and harvest according to shared rules. Participants have different amounts of free time and gardening experience. Which arrangement would better sustain participation and make good use of the available land?
skills: 解释合作中的责任 / 扩展贡献的衡量方式
vocabulary: shared beds / harvest rules / watering schedule
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: shared beds 是共同照料的种植区；要权衡个人付出与收获的对应、互相补位的便利。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。

material: Professor: An elementary school has enough money for either one full-day visit to a distant nature center or several short visits to a nearby stream during the school year. timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: curious observers 是愿意提问并观察的人；题目权衡少见体验与反复追踪的学习。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。

material: Professor: An intermediate language class watches short films as part of its weekly lessons. material: Professor: A university degree includes several elective courses that students may take outside their main subject. material: Professor: A housing organization is considering placing university students and older residents in the same apartment building. material: Professor: A visitor center sells souvenirs that help fund its information service. rationale: locally made 是本地制作；题目权衡支持本地制作、游客预算与信息服务经费。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。

material: Professor: A history museum is redesigning a small gallery containing fragile everyday objects from an earlier period. material: Professor: A community repair workshop teaches simple clothing repairs. material: Professor: A neighborhood grocery cooperative is considering opening on fewer days but staying open later on those days. material: Professor: A secondary school is reviewing its daily timetable. One proposal adds twenty minutes to the lunch break and ends lessons twenty minutes later, without changing teaching time. material: Professor: A small community theater wants more residents to attend its performances. answer_evidence: 范文新增把购票与私下自愿支持分开：先确认低价，再选额外捐助，不换座位等级或公开表扬；预算只算可预计票款和已承诺支持，不能把愿意多付的可能性当确定收入。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A college wants students to collaborate with peers in another country. Its budget could support a short overseas visit for a small group or a semester of online projects open to many more students. Both options include guidance from teachers at each institution. Which should be the main focus of the college's international learning program?
skills: 把交流目标落实为合作任务 / 限定替代方案的收益与边界
vocabulary: online projects / shared equipment / time zone
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: online projects 是线上合作项目；要权衡亲身接触的深度与更多人持续参与的机会。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。
answer_evidence: 范文新增共同解决找安静自习地点的问题，以观察和共写指南让差异自然出现，避免只介绍国家印象；共享设备、轮换开会时间回应参与门槛，也承认线上不能复制所有到访体验。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。
